name: Wildmutt
abilities: Enhanced smell, hearing and taste; expert tracking
Sharp teeth and enhanced bite force
Sharp claws; wall scaling and digging
Enhanced speed and agility (faster than a cheetah)
weaknesses: High-frequency sounds (dog whistles) overwhelm his hearing
A cold blocks his neck nostrils and leaves him effectively blind
summary: A blind, orange, ape-gaited beast that 'sees' by scent and sound; Ben's go-to for tracking, brawling and clawing up walls.
traits: No eyes, ears or nose - gill-like nostrils on the neck
Body spines act as tactile whiskers
Only Ben alien that cannot talk
notableFeats: Defeated one of Vilgax's Mechadroids in his first outing (And Then There Were 10)
Sniffed out and beat the Limax impersonating Max (Permanent Retirement)
Threw Eon out of the timeline (Ben 10: Race Against Time)
Held his own against Buglizard (Of Predators and Prey: Part 1)
Defeated the Twin Knights at the Highbreed pulse generator (Return to Forever)
Went Ultimate against Prisoner 775 and the Esoterica (UA)

appearances.designNotes: Vivid orange fur, black lips and claws, black-and-white shoulder brace holding the original Omnitrix on the left shoulder. Ben 10,000's Wildmutt is larger, striped, has a tail and wears the Omnitrix on his forehead; 4-year-old 'Wildpup' is a small version.
16-year-old: lighter skin, lips coloured like the fur, Ultimatrix on the chest (no brace). 10-year-old (Forge of Creation): OS look with all-black brace and green Omnitrix.

image.label: UA
image.notes: Infobox image labelled UA (episode screenshot rather than a render).

appearances.firstEpisode: Have I Got a Deal for You
notableEpisodes: Have I Got a Deal for You
appearances.designNotes: Black lips return, bigger forearms; 16-year-old wears a green-and-white collar with the Omnitrix. 11-year-old keeps the OS black-and-white shoulder brace with a green Omnitrix.

scoring.rationale: Solid melee bruiser with cheetah-plus speed and unbeatable tracking senses, but purely close-range and unable to communicate. Sonic whistles and strong smells shut his senses down; his beastly form makes finesse tasks hard.

notes: Alien Force: locked in Ben 10 Returns; wiki History says re-unlocked by the Master Control in War of the Worlds: Part 1 but he is NOT listed among AF on-screen appearances - no AF record.
UA 'Fame' appearance is only footage on TV (10-year-old); Viktor: The Spoils is a hologram cameo; first real 16-year-old UA use is Prisoner Number 775 is Missing.
Also used by Kevin (Inspector 13, via Ultimatrix), Carl (Destroy All Aliens) and No Watch Ben (And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.
Ultimate Wildmutt (UA) is the Ultimatrix evolution.
